def compute_metrics(labels, preds):

@torch.no_grad()

    model.eval()
    all_labels, all_preds = [], []
    for padded, labels, lengths in loader:
        logits = model(padded.to(device), lengths)
        preds = (torch.sigmoid(logits) >= 0.5).long().cpu()

# oh_train_single.py — Train one OH probe on a single GPU
import argparse, json, random, sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np, torch, torch.nn as nn
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score, accuracy_score
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from probe_model import ProgressProbe, WindowDataset, collate_fn, split_by_instance

PROJECT = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/agent_progress_probe")
OH_DIR = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/openhands_data")
SWE_CKPT = PROJECT / "checkpoints_full" / "best_model.pt"

def set_seed(s):
    random.seed(s); np.random.seed(s); torch.manual_seed(s); torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(s)

def compute_metrics(y, p):
    return {"macro_f1": round(f1_score(y, p, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
            "accuracy": round(accuracy_score(y, p), 4),
            "f1_stagnation": round(f1_score(y, p, pos_label=0, zero_division=0), 4),
            "f1_progress": round(f1_score(y, p, pos_label=1, zero_division=0), 4)}

@torch.no_grad()
def eval_model(model, loader, device):
    model.eval()
    yl, yp = [], []
    for pad, lab, lens in loader:
        logits = model(pad.to(device), lens)
        pred = (torch.sigmoid(logits) >= 0.5).long().cpu()
        yl.extend(lab.long().tolist()); yp.extend(pred.tolist())
    return yl, yp

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--mode", required=True, choices=["finetune", "scratch"])
    p.add_argument("--gpu", type=int, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
    args = p.parse_args()
    set_seed(42)
    device = f"cuda:{args.gpu}"
    out = Path(args.output_dir); out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    data = torch.load(OH_DIR / "embeddings_fixed.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
    embs, labs, iids, confs = data["embeddings"], data["labels"], data["instance_ids"], data["confidences"]
    embed_dim = data["embed_dim"]
    keep = [i for i, c in enumerate(confs) if c >= 2]
    embs = [embs[i] for i in keep]; labs = [labs[i] for i in keep]; iids = [iids[i] for i in keep]
    print(f"[{args.mode}@gpu{args.gpu}] {len(labs)} windows (conf>=2), stag={Counter(labs)[0]}")

    tri, vai, tei = split_by_instance(iids, seed=42)
    trd = WindowDataset([embs[i] for i in tri], [labs[i] for i in tri])
    vad = WindowDataset([embs[i] for i in vai], [labs[i] for i in vai])
    ted = WindowDataset([embs[i] for i in tei], [labs[i] for i in tei])
    trl = [labs[i] for i in tri]; np_ = sum(trl); nn_ = len(trl)-np_
    pw = torch.tensor([nn_/max(np_,1)]).to(device)
    print(f"  train={len(tri)} val={len(vai)} test={len(tei)} pos_w={pw.item():.3f}")

    trl_loader = DataLoader(trd, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    val_loader = DataLoader(vad, batch_size=64, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    test_loader = DataLoader(ted, batch_size=64, collate_fn=collate_fn)

    if args.mode == "finetune":
        ckpt = torch.load(SWE_CKPT, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
        model = ProgressProbe(embed_dim=ckpt["embed_dim"], hidden_size=ckpt["hidden_size"],
                              num_layers=ckpt["num_layers"], dropout=ckpt.get("dropout",0.1))
        model.load_state_dict(ckpt["model_state_dict"]); lr = 1e-4
    else:
        model = ProgressProbe(embed_dim=embed_dim, hidden_size=256, num_layers=2, dropout=0.1); lr = 1e-3

    model.to(device)
    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr, weight_decay=0.01)
    crit = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=pw)
    best_f1, best_st, best_ep, pat = 0, None, 0, 0

    for ep in range(1, 21):
        model.train(); tl, ns = 0.0, 0
        for pad, bl, lens in trl_loader:
            logits = model(pad.to(device), lens)
            loss = crit(logits, bl.to(device))
            opt.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); opt.step()
            tl += loss.item()*len(bl); ns += len(bl)
        vl, vp = eval_model(model, val_loader, device)
        vf = f1_score(vl, vp, average="macro", zero_division=0)
        imp = vf > best_f1
        if imp: best_f1, best_ep = vf, ep; best_st = {k:v.cpu().clone() for k,v in model.state_dict().items()}; pat = 0
        else: pat += 1
        print(f"E{ep:2d} loss={tl/ns:.4f} val_F1={vf:.4f}{' *' if imp else ''}")
        if pat >= 5: print(f"Early stop at epoch {ep}"); break

    model.load_state_dict(best_st); model.to(device)
    tl_, tp_ = eval_model(model, test_loader, device)
    tm = compute_metrics(tl_, tp_)
    print(f"DONE best_epoch={best_ep} test={tm}")
    torch.save({"model_state_dict": best_st, "embed_dim": embed_dim, "hidden_size": 256,
                "num_layers": 2, "dropout": 0.1, "best_epoch": best_ep, "test_metrics": tm,
                "mode": args.mode}, out / "best_model.pt")
    torch.save({"test_labels": tl_, "test_preds": tp_, "test_idx": tei,
                "train_idx": tri, "val_idx": vai, "keep_indices": keep}, out / "test_preds.pt")
    with open(out / "results.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump({"best_epoch": best_ep, "best_val_f1": round(best_f1,4), "test_metrics": tm}, f, indent=2)
    print(f"METRICS_JSON={json.dumps(tm)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
